svg.title: Route, temperature and cooling power during a climb
svg.desc: Three panels from the original source show a long climb, a battery kept within the admissible temperature window by feedback or predictive control, and predictive pre-cooling before the climb followed by recovery. Curves and their timing are unchanged from the original; axes are qualitative.
svg.text: Same time axis across all three panels
Level road → long climb → level road.
Both stay in the admissible window.
Predictive control uses the window before the climb.
Predictive pre-cooling reduces power on the climb.
